purpose: Test specification only. JSON files do not import as native SOLIDWORKS studies.

studies.name: Import, units, axes and mate audit
acceptance_criteria: 300/250/40 mm arm spans within 0.1 mm import check
27 intended rotations and no unintended translation with driving mates suppressed
no import or rebuild errors

studies.name: 27 individual conservative sweeps
studies.tool_required: Animation for kinematic review; Motion Analysis add-in for quantitative dynamics

planned_settings.complete_range_sweep: follow only after conservative sweep, with interference review

outputs_required: required torque/reaction curves only if defensible dynamics inputs exist
acceptance_criteria: angle deviation <= 0.5 degrees from scheduled values
correct sign and continuous paths
no unexplained motion or solver error
motor torque/speed/payload acceptance remains pending actual drive ratings

studies.name: Shell clearance and interference
studies.tool_required: Interference Detection and Clearance Verification; collision/contact review for moving edges
acceptance_criteria: zero unexplained intersections
>=0.5 mm nominal non-contacting shell gap as provisional design-review target
pin/pad/bearing fit criteria separately specified
sampling alone does not prove continuous clearance

studies.name: Single tendon finger small-angle fit
studies.tool_required: SOLIDWORKS assembly and Animation; Motion Analysis for modeled tendon dynamics
inputs_required: physical servo/horn measurements before transmission fit claim
real cord routing/stiffness/pretension and elastic return for coupled study

planned_settings.warning: Straight cord reference solids do not implement a deformable tendon. PWM microseconds are not calibrated joint degrees.

outputs_required: torque/tension only after transmission model exists
acceptance_criteria: free 0/5/10/15 degree individual hinge movement and return without unintended contact
retainer/screw envelopes clear
modeled transmission explains all 3 hinge motions
physical printed fit and stop angle remain unvalidated

studies.name: Structural load cases and actuator sizing
studies.tool_required: Appropriate SOLIDWORKS Simulation; SimulationXpress only for a separate single solid-body linear first pass
acceptance_criteria: reaction balance <=1% proposed numerical review target
meaningful non-singular stress and deflection last-refinement change <5%
hardware-specific safety/deflection/fatigue criteria satisfied only after selected
correct linear/nonlinear/dynamic assumptions

studies.name: Vision/controller replay boundary
studies.tool_required: Separate documented API/co-simulation bridge would be needed
acceptance_criteria: trajectory playback labeled replay, never autonomous vision proof
existing MuJoCo camera results remain labeled MuJoCo results
